newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks at day's lows in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: French stocks at day's lows in quiet trade.

text.p: French shares were trading at the day's lows on the last day of the monthly settlement in what dealers said was technically driven trade.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 19.62 points or 0.71 percent at 2,737.65 at 1151 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was down 22.5 points from Friday's close.
* Insurer GAN off 3.07 pct at 120.0 francs amid worries new Socialist government may lift tax breaks on life insurance products.
* Luxury goods group LVMH off 2.48 pct at 1,493.0, retracing some of Friday's gains.
